items.title: CCPA Takes Action Against Ola Over Advance Tipping, Imposes INR 10 Lakh Penalty
items.snippet: CCPA has issued a fine of INR 10 lakh on Ola operator ANI Technologies for its advance tipping feature, saying it amounted to misleading conduct and violated the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Regulator told Ola to turn off the feature and pull back the prompts.

items.title: BEML Plans Domestic Production of Tunnel-Boring Machines to Challenge China's Dominance
items.snippet: BEML Ltd. will soon begin making indigenous TBMs in the country to minimise dependence on Chinese imports and increase domestic manufacturing of infrastructure equipment. The corporation will first create smaller TBMs of 3.5 to 6.5 meters for hydropower, irrigation, water and metro projects.

items.title: Haldiram Snacks Prepares for Mega IPO, Eyes INR 10,000 Crore Valuation in 2027
items.snippet: Haldiram Snacks Food has kicked off the groundwork for its expected IPO, choosing EY as the book running lead manager and aiming for a listing by the end of 2027. The company is rumoured to be contemplating an IPO of about INR 10,000 crore at a valuation of more than INR 1 lakh crore.
